title.en: Put the date in the index

hints.tr: Tek gün `s.loc["2024-03-09"]`, bütün ay `s.loc["2024-03"]`, bütün yıl `s.loc["2024"]`.
hints.en: One day is `s.loc["2024-03-09"]`, the whole month `s.loc["2024-03"]`, the whole year `s.loc["2024"]`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd

s = pd.read_csv("store_sales.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)["sales"]

print(type(s.index).__name__)
print(s.loc["2024-03-09"])
print(s.loc["2024-03"].sum())
print(round(float(s.loc["2024"].mean()), 1))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd

s = pd.read_csv("store_sales.csv", index_col="date", parse_dates=True)["sales"]

print(type(s.index).__name__)
print(s.loc["2024-03-09"])
print(s.loc["2024-03"].sum())
print(round(float(s.loc["2024"].mean()), 1))
```
